deployment_scope.note: v5 replaces the selective v4 structural/fallback center with one integrated pre-poll prior: R4 structural offset + ridge-shrunk candidate residual offset + T3 non-major mass + legacy within-nonmajor allocation, followed by the existing joint polling likelihood and strong-fragmentation gate.

scope: Taiwan county/city executive election candidate vote shares and winner probabilities

major_party_center.structural_offset: Partisan Baseline 4.0A weighted regularized KMT-DPP model

candidate_residual_offset.application: additive logit residual offset on top of the R4 structural center

nonmajor_mass.allocation: legacy candidate fundamentals only within the non-major pool

turnout.reason: cycle-centered turnout produced negligible 2022 improvement after the v5.0 availability/cycle proxy was removed, and no earlier independent temporal cycle was available to validate a stable effect

polling.stage: downstream likelihood after the integrated pre-poll prior

strong_fragmentation_gate.action: recenter the posterior draw cloud to the full named-candidate poll vector in CLR space

winner_probability.method: joint Monte Carlo candidate-share simulation after structural and polling updates

candidate_offset_chronological_2022.note: The candidate-offset feature scope was selected on 2018 and frozen before this v5.2 scoring, but 2022 had already been inspected elsewhere in the broader project.

end_to_end_development_2022.reason_not_confirmatory: The fragmentation architecture itself was developed after inspection of earlier 2022 errors.

confirmatory_reference_2022.model: v4.0 selective RC3 before post-holdout fragmentation development

production_isomorphic_shadow_2026.leader_change: 高雄市：柯志恩 -> 賴瑞隆

stable_blockers: end-to-end 2022 v5.3 metrics are development diagnostics, not a pristine architecture-blind holdout
winner probabilities remain uncalibrated across multiple independent election cycles
raw 2006 local-executive files are not in the auditable repository and are not claimed as integrated
